name: watch
description: Let the agent watch a video, screen recording, or audio file — URL or local path. Downloads with yt-dlp, extracts frames with ffmpeg, pulls captions or falls back to Whisper, and can also measure motion and animation timing/easing (--motion), characterize editing style and pacing, and read small on-screen text via --crop.

interface.shortDescription: Give the agent a video input — watch, transcribe, and measure motion, animation timing and editing pacing from a URL or local file.
interface.longDescription: watch adds a skill that lets the agent watch any video, screen recording, or audio file: it downloads with yt-dlp, extracts auto-scaled frames with ffmpeg, pulls a timestamped transcript from native captions (or the Whisper API as a fallback), and hands frames + transcript to the model. Beyond Q&A and summaries it measures motion — animation timing, transition durations, easing curves (--motion) — characterizes editing style and pacing from the full detected-cut list, and crops regions so small on-screen text is legible.
defaultPrompt: /watch https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ what happens at the 30 second mark?
